message.content: Yes—geographically the United States lies entirely within the continent of **North America**. It shares borders with Canada to the north and Mexico to the south (and has maritime boundaries with several other countries). In terms of continental divisions, North America includes Canada, the U.S., Mexico, Central American nations, and many Caribbean islands—all part of the same landmass.
